scope: CVG-004 durable counter-sale cancellation provenance and tenant-scoped history

criteria.description: The cancellation boundary requires exactly a validated reason, rejects control characters before trim, derives actor/account/correlation from the authenticated command and requires the existing idempotency header.
criteria.limitations: The boundary proof is repository-local and does not certify an external identity provider or target deployment.

criteria.description: Database cancellation locks the account-scoped sale, accepts only an open row, updates with an account predicate and verified row count, and appends one actor/reason/before-after/correlation audit event in the same tenant transaction.
criteria.limitations: The proof uses disposable PostgreSQL and does not certify target schema rollout or legal audit retention.

criteria.description: Repeated and concurrent cancellation attempts do not create duplicate provenance; history reads are committed, newest-first, cold-projection safe, account-scoped and RLS-isolated.
criteria.limitations: Browser-level replay across restarted API instances remains a separate E2E/target evidence item; the command, transaction and RLS boundaries are covered here.

criteria.description: The detail response exposes cancellationHistory without relabelling the existing cancelled-sales snapshot, and both sales workbenches collect and send the required reason.
criteria.limitations: The browser evidence is focused sales-workbench coverage, not the complete enterprise E2E/release suite.

criteria.description: Transaction/audit failure restores the in-memory projection and does not publish history; audit persistence failure state is isolated per event so a later valid write can succeed.
criteria.limitations: This hardens the existing audit seam only; it does not redesign audit storage, tamper evidence or retention.

criteria.description: TDD RED preceded implementation and the final focused, compiled-route, full API and PostgreSQL regressions are green.
criteria.limitations: Local regression does not certify remote CI, target operations or release acceptance.

criteria.description: Official coverage and repository quality gates remain above the mandated threshold, with migration-source, OpenAPI, RLS, secret, formatting and diff checks green.
criteria.limitations: Coverage is workspace-local and includes one explicitly skipped external laboratory test; it is not a release certificate.

criteria.description: Independent review findings were reconciled and retested; the final attempted independent sign-off timed out and therefore supplies no approval, so the bounded decision carries medium confidence and explicit residuals.
criteria.limitations: No final independent APPROVE verdict was obtained after the time-boxed reviewer attempt; closure relies on the completed review findings, direct fixes and fresh regression evidence.

gaps: Mixed mode with a database counter-sales repository and an in-memory audit repository does not provide restart-durable history; the mode is explicit and remains a separate deployment residual.
Existing cancellations are intentionally not backfilled, and no cancelledAt fact is inferred from updatedAt or the snapshot report.
Browser replay across restarted instances, target operations, external providers, remote CI, backup/restore and release acceptance remain open.
Parent CVG-004, global Vetus/clinical parity and ERP promotion remain open.
conditions: Keep new cancellation writes on the tenant UoW/transaction boundary whenever the database repository is active.
Keep actor and account principal-derived; never accept either from the request body.
Do not backfill or infer provenance for pre-existing cancelled rows.
Keep mixed-mode history limitations explicit until a durable audit repository is configured.
Keep global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
Do not infer target, production, provider, deployment or release acceptance from this local gate.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation, convergent scouting and bounded review reconciliation
authority.scope: Repository-local counter-sale cancellation reason validation, principal-derived provenance, tenant-scoped atomic status/audit write, committed history read, minimal SPA/contract wiring and tests
authority.decision: Authorize bounded local closure of new cancellation provenance only. Exclude fiscal, payments/refunds, audit-framework redesign, legal retention, historical backfill, providers, credentials, FIDO2, target, production, deployment, release and global ERP acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing cancellation semantics, adding backfill/legal retention, touching fiscal/payment workflows, changing audit storage, or entering target/production/deployment/release scope.

next_action: Close this bounded task, return to fresh independent scouting and create a new implementation-ready authority before touching the next ERP gap. Keep parent CVG-004 and global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL with promotion BLOCKED.
revalidation_triggers: Changing counter-sale close, reopen, payment, fiscal or refund semantics
Adding audit retention, tamper evidence, backfill or a new persistence provider
Changing target, production, deployment, backup/restore or release boundaries
